messages:
incident-bot: PAGED #eng-oncall: P1 - surge in 5xx across inference-gateway in us-west-2, alerting rule: gateway_error_rate > 5% for 3m. Links: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/5xx-overview

alex: grabbing this. seeing a spike coincident with increased traffic to embedder-v2 pool. 504/502 primarily.

maya: logs show upstream timeouts to model-host-02 and model-host-07: `upstream_status=504` and `connect_timeout` errors. rolling deploys?

alex: no active deploys in last 30m. running curl to host directly now.``
$ curl -v http://model-host-02:8080/health``

ingrid: adding short-term silence for the noisy alert while we investigate (silence id:sil-431). will keep paging active for CPU/memory alerts.

paul: what's customer impact looking like? any 429s or just 5xx from gateway?

alex: error returns to customers ~3.1% of requests in last 5m per logs. mostly long polling chat endpoints timing out. Flagging as impacting low-latency clients.

maya: mitigation attempt: scaling inference-gateway pool + draining model-host-07. kicking autoscaler to add 2 replicas now.``
/ops autoscale inference-gateway --add 2``

incident-bot: ACTION: Autoscale job started by maya (job id: as-998). Estimated completion 90s.

ingrid: I'm patching the alert rule so we don't get stormed by duplicates while we confirm root cause. Changing prometheus rule: increase window to 5m and threshold to 8% for now. Patch:``
- alert: Gateway5xxSpike
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\",status=~\"5..\"}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\"}[1m])) > 0.05
+ alert: Gateway5xxSpike
+  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\"}[5m])) > 0.08
``
Applying and will monitor.

paul: create a quick dashboard panel for 5xx by upstream host and latency distribution. want to see if single upstream is root cause.

alex: added panel under /dashboards/ops/5xx-by-upstream and pinned to incident.

maya: autoscaler finished. added 2 gateway pods. immediate 5xx rate down to 1.7% in 3m window. looks promising.

ingrid: rolling drain of model-host-07 shows high connection errors; discovered OOM kill events in dmesg for that host. seems model-host-07 is unhealthy. quarantining it from pool.

paul: recorded customer impact: transient failures for some chat sessions; estimated affected sessions 0.9% of active sessions over incident window. notifying CS with summary.

alex: created internal ticket INC-2314 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2314) - actions: replace model-host-07, verify autoscaler config, tighten circuit-breaker to upstreams.

ingrid: follow-up: will revert alert rule to original after 24h if stable, but add a new rule: `Gateway5xxByUpstream` that fires if a single upstream contributes >50% of 5xx for 5m. creating PR.

maya: adding runbook note: if 5xx spike and autoscale doesn't reduce rates, check model-host OOM and upstream health before scaling more. Also recommend increasing probe timeout from 2s -> 5s for model hosts.

tom: thanks team, I'm taking watch for the next 2h to monitor for regressions. leaving a handoff note in #oncall-handoffs. :thumbsup:

paul: post-incident tasking: schedule an alert tuning & dashboard review session tomorrow 11am. owners: ingrid, alex, maya.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: severity downgraded to P3 at 2151235111. Root cause: model-host-07 OOM -> upstream timeouts -> gateway 5xx spike. Mitigation: quarantined host + autoscale.

alex: quick retrospective notes: need better contamination isolation for single-host failure, and alerts that distinguish distributed vs single-upstream failures.

ingrid: noted. will open RFC for upstream-level alerting thresholds + automated quarantining heuristic.

tom: handoff complete. I'll escalate if we see reappearance.

maya: closing silence (sil-431) in 30m if metrics remain stable.

paul: thanks everyone. I'll draft the customer-facing incident summary and share in #customer-impact once ready.
